q: What can we discuss in a software consulting engagement?
a: We can discuss custom software, web and mobile applications, SaaS products, architecture reviews, integrations and workflow automation. The first step is to understand your business problem and agree on a useful scope.

q: Can we start by improving one existing workflow?
a: Yes. A focused workflow is a practical starting point. We can review the tools, handoffs and constraints involved, then discuss a suitable first release before planning a broader system.

q: Do you work with businesses outside Coimbatore?
a: We welcome project discussions with businesses in Coimbatore, across India and internationally. Delivery arrangements, communication and scope are agreed during project discovery.

q: How are project timelines and costs decided?
a: Timelines and costs depend on requirements, integrations, data migration, testing and support needs. Share your goals through our project inquiry form so the scope can be discussed before a proposal is agreed.
